title: Ada and the Cover
author: Yara Thornbury
blurb: Isandro Voss, a private security contractor guarding clients nobody trusts, has spent ten years following rules that keep getting rewritten. Then every record of a flight vanishes while it's still in the air — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must extract a defector who may be the bait, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
